title: Fix Chat and Settings Navbar Toggle Exclusivity
description: Fix remaining issues with chat/settings navbar toggles: (1) PanelToggles returns null when no left/right tabs exist, hiding chat/settings toggles - they should always be visible, (2) expectOnlyLeftAndRightPanelTogglesInNavbar test incorrectly expects settingsToggleCount===0 and chatToggleCount===0 but verifyDesignNavbarSettingsIsAvailable expects them to be visible - update the test, (3) ensure only one of chat/settings/rightSidePanel can be active at a time via EXCLUSIVE_SIDE_PANEL_KEYS.
